contract_guarantees: Strict frozen Pydantic models with extra fields forbidden.
Every commitment decision has exactly one coherent nullable reason tuple.
Every authority decision has coherent support-reference, axis, and finding requirements.
Unsupported authority decisions require at least one linked DECISIVE governed finding.
Findings cannot be missing, orphaned, reused, or linked to another entry.
Candidate proposition references and authority support references enforce distinct source roles.
Controller receipt models independently reject direct state-bypass construction.
Controller builders preserve raw response hashes and never repair responses.

blocker_repair.repair: Added strict receipt-level validators for expected-entry identity, parse state, record coverage, source state, error state, and deterministic zero-entry invariants.
